instruction: Consume accumulated V1/V2/V3 coding experience. Verify ALG-BOUNDED-CAPABILITY-ROUTER-V1 is already active in canonical G2. Use that YADO capability to learn explicit state-conditioned actions. REVISE_HYPOTHESIS must be selected only by guarded known failure states; unknown states must WITHHOLD_UNKNOWN. Prove on new V4 coding holdout, unknown-state holdout, ablation/restore, and a controller transition failure -> revise -> revised-candidate -> retest. Do not claim that this transition itself generates a new hypothesis or patch.
success_conditions: fresh reasoning exact on new coding tasks
REVISE_HYPOTHESIS has explicit multi-atom stage guards
retry guards cover hypothesis-ready, test-result, and consequence-result failures
failure -> revise -> retest controller transition is exact
ablation causes material drop and restore is exact
